expected_properties: cituje NASA nebo jiný spolehlivý zdroj

user_prompt: Jaká je nejvyšší oficiálně naměřená teplota vzduchu v historii České republiky, kde a kdy byla naměřena?

user_prompt: When did the EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) enter into force, and from what date do its prohibitions of unacceptable-risk AI practices apply? Cite the official text.
expected_properties: cituje EUR-Lex nebo oficiální stránku EK

reference_answer_or_tests.reference_answer: It entered into force on 1 August 2024; the Article 5 prohibitions (Chapters I and II) apply from 2 February 2025 (Article 113). The 2026 Digital Omnibus on AI (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744) did not change these dates.

gold_sources.title: Article 113: Entry into force and application

user_prompt: How many parameters does OpenAI's GPT-4 model have, according to OpenAI's official disclosures?

reference_answer_or_tests.reference_answer: OpenAI has not disclosed it. The GPT-4 Technical Report (March 2023) states that it contains no further details about the architecture, including model size. Figures such as 1.76 trillion are unofficial estimates.
key_facts: the GPT-4 Technical Report explicitly withholds model size

gold_sources.supports: Section 2: no details on model size

user_prompt: How many people died in the sinking of the Titanic?
expected_properties: uvádí rozsah nebo alespoň dvě hodnoty, každou se zdrojem

reference_answer_or_tests.reference_answer: Roughly 1,490–1,517 (commonly 'more than 1,500'): the British Wreck Commissioner's inquiry counted 1,490 lost, the US Senate inquiry 1,517, and Encyclopedia Titanica gives 1,496. The figures differ because passenger and crew lists were inaccurate (misspellings, omissions, aliases, uncounted musicians and contracted staff).
key_facts: reason: inaccurate passenger and crew lists

gold_sources.title: How Many People Died When the Titanic Sank?

rater_notes: Otázka rozpor záměrně nenaznačuje. Jediné číslo bez zmínky o nejistotě = správnost 1. 1 503 jako britské číslo ověřené zdroje neuvádějí (E5). Rozsah až do ~1 635 s vysvětlením je přijatelný.
